faq.q: How much do people earn in Singapore by sector?
faq.a: It depends on the sector, role and seniority, pick a sector guide above for typical monthly base ranges across engineering, IT, healthcare, manufacturing, logistics and commercial roles, all from our own read of the Singapore market.

faq.q: What affects how much someone earns?
faq.a: Sector, the exact role and seniority, the hiring company and industry, professional registration or certifications, and how scarce the skill set is all move pay, two jobs with the same title can be very different.

faq.q: Do these salary figures include bonus and CPF?
faq.a: These are monthly basic salaries, before AWS, bonus, commission, overtime, shift and site allowances. What people actually take home is often higher, so treat these as the starting point, not the full package.

faq.q: How current is this salary data?
faq.a: We keep them current. We track what employers across the Singapore market are advertising for each role and seniority, and set that against what we see when we actually fill these roles. Where our own figure differs from the advertised one, ours is the one we publish. The market moves, so treat them as an informed guide rather than a fixed rate card, and ask us for a read on a specific role.

faq.q: How do I get an accurate salary benchmark for a specific role?
faq.a: Tell us the title, the scope and where the role is based, and we’ll come back, at no cost, with a sharper range for your exact hire and what comparable employers are paying.
